# Reddy Tours & Travels

> Maharashtra-based cab and car rental service offering Mumbai–Pune express cabs, All-India outstation taxis, local hourly packages, corporate employee transport, wedding fleets, and self-drive intercity cars. Zero surge pricing, sanitized AC vehicles, and police-verified chauffeurs.

## Key facts

- Business name: Reddy Tours & Travels
- Service area: Maharashtra, India (Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Kolhapur, Solapur, Nagpur, Latur, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Alibaug) plus pan-India outstation
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98600 13081
- Email: booking@reddytourstravels.com
- Hours: 24/7, all days
- Payment: Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer; GST invoices available
- Availability: 24x7 doorstep pickup, zero advance required for inquiries

## Services

- Mumbai–Pune Express Corridor: fixed-price one-way and round-trip cabs, toll-inclusive options, starting at ₹1,799.
- All-India Outstation: All India Tourist Permit fleet, from ₹11/km (Sedan), ₹14/km (SUV), ₹18/km (Innova Crysta), ₹24/km (Tempo Traveller).
- Local Hourly Packages: 8 hrs/80 km from ₹1,999, 10 hrs/100 km from ₹2,499, 12 hrs/120 km from ₹2,999 (fuel and driver included).
- Events & Weddings: decorated luxury groom/bridal cars and guest shuttle tempo travellers.
- Corporate Employee Pick-Drop: monthly retainer contracts, centralized rosters, GST billing, background-checked drivers.
- Self-Drive Intercity: cars without chauffeur, digital licence and Aadhaar verification, from ₹1,499/day.

## Fleet

- Maruti Suzuki Dzire / Toyota Etios (4-seater sedan)
- Maruti Ertiga / Kia Carens (6-seater SUV)
- Toyota Innova Crysta / Hycross (7-seater luxury MPV)
- Force Tempo Traveller (13 / 17 / 26 seater)

## Frequently asked questions

- How does WhatsApp booking work? Select pickup and drop city, choose car and date, then click "Book on WhatsApp"; a coordinator confirms car and driver details immediately.
- Are tolls and parking included? One-way Mumbai–Pune packages are toll-inclusive; outstation tolls and permits are billed at actual Fastag receipts.
- Can I book multi-city outstation tours across India? Yes, All India Tourist Permit cabs are available for multi-day interstate tours.
- How does Self-Drive work? Rent without a chauffeur after digital licence and Aadhaar verification; hub pickup or doorstep delivery.
- What is the cost of a Mumbai to Pune cab? Sedan from ₹1,799, Premium SUV from about ₹2,599, Innova Crysta from about ₹3,499.
